mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a multi-room remodel in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for a multi-room remodel in Berkeley, look for experience with similar projects, strong local references, and proper licensing and insurance. A good contractor should communicate clearly, provide detailed proposals, and have a proven track record of staying on schedule and within budget. Frasheski Construction has extensive experience in the Berkeley area and is committed to transparent communication and quality workmanship.
